configuration.completion_rule: Planner declares finished after zero observed-map frontier nodes on three fresh scans. Evaluator coverage percentage never controls completion.
configuration.coverage_definition: Fixed 25 cm floor samples within 19 cm of fresh LiDAR returns and 15 cm of capture-time foot-support height; flat elevations require physical arrival within 35 cm in 3D and 8 cm vertically. Levels counted separately.
configuration.dose_definition: Integrated simulated true dose-equivalent proxy in micro-sieverts.
configuration.timing: Independent simulated clocks, fixed 0.5 s planning latency; curves end at each mission end.

final.completion_scope: planner-declared frontier exhaustion; reference floor percentage is evaluation only

survey_report.scope: 3D floor observations from physically reached elevations; admissibility only where known support/return routes exist

survey_report.scope: 3D floor observations from physically reached elevations; admissibility only where known support/return routes exist

scope: One retained paired reactor development experiment; ideal-pose planning comparison, not a multi-seed or hardware validation. Both incomplete outcomes are retained.
distance_definition: distance_m integrates actual 3D base displacement at every physics tick. path_length_m is the separate historical displacement-gated diagnostic; do not substitute it.

verification.scope: local full Go2 suite on Linux ARM64; remote CI status is separate

matched.scope: First recorded >= threshold crossing at 0.5 s telemetry cadence, not equal routes or an optimal-tour result. Common-time values use linear interpolation.
